name: manual_64abea
claim: Bind CI evidence to its tested checkout and tree: record merge, base and PR-head revisions and require equality with the operator-accepted head tree or rerun that exact head.

decisions.notes: Orama477 review found synthetic merge CI described as exact-head evidence without a tree binding; the review procedure now requires the comparison and retains the merge barrier.
